# Compaktt School – בית ספר ל-DJ (ירושלים והמרכז)

> Compaktt School is a DJ school in Israel: private DJ lessons in a studio in Jerusalem and a group
> course in central Israel, taught in Hebrew by DJ Almog Cohen (14 years on stage, 1,000+ events).
> Students learn from zero on professional gear (Pioneer XDJ-RX3, DDJ-1000) and go out to real events.

## Tracks and prices
- חבילת בסיס (Basic): 3 sessions of 90 minutes, home exercises, 3 months of support. 1,500 ₪.
- התמחות שטח (Field): 6 sessions of 90 minutes, one real event in the field, 6 months of support. 3,800 ₪ + VAT.
- מסלול PRO: 8 sessions, 2 field outings, support at your first event, DJ and business Zoom sessions,
  a sound and lighting session, a year of support. 7,000 ₪ + VAT.

## Where
- Private lessons: a studio in Jerusalem (ירושלים).
- Group course: central Israel (המרכז).
- Exact details are arranged on WhatsApp.

## Good to know
- No experience needed; the tracks start from zero.
- All equipment is provided in the lessons; for practice at home free DJ software and headphones are enough.
- Every track includes phone and WhatsApp support after the lessons.
